name: Kamiji Ritsu
source: Ritsu Kamiji, 22 years old - Female. Aims to liberate Psychics. Met Tsukiko as a subject in the Latoua Lab, destroyed it upon escape. Can use both Teleportation and Electrokinesis. Known as the strongest psychic.
